title.zh: 将伊莎贝拉省重新划分为六个立法选区的法案
title.en: An Act Reapportioning the Province of Isabela Into Six (6) Legislative Districts
title.orig: An Act Reapportioning the Province of Isabela Into Six (6) Legislative Districts

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2018/ra_11080_2018.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Legislative Districts. - The Province of Isabela is hereby reapportioned into six (6) legislative districts to commence in the next national and local elections after the effectivity of this Act. Each district shall be composed of the following:
(a) FIRST LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT:
(1) Iligan City
(2) Cabagan
(3) Delfin Albano
(4) Divilacan
(5) Maconacon
(6) Tumauini
(7) San Pablo
(8) Sta. Maria
(9) Sto. Tomas
(b) SECOND LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT
(1) Benito Soliven
(2) Palanan
(3) Naguilian
(4) Reina Mercedes
(5) San Mariano
(6) Gamu
(c) THIRD LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT:
(1) Alicia
(2) Cabatuan
(3) San Mateo
(4) Ramon
(5) Angadanan
(d) FOURTH LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT:
(1) Santiago City
(2) Cordon
(3) Dinapigue
(4) San Agustin
(5) Jones
(e) FIFTH LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT
(1) Aurora
(2) Burgos
(3) Luna
(4) Mallig
(5) Quezon
(6) Quirino
(7) Roxas
(8) San Manuel
(f) SIXTH LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT:
(1) Cauayan City
(2) Echague
(3) San Guillermo
(4) San Isidro

Incumbent Representatives. - The incumbent Representatives of the Province of Isabela shall continue to represent their respective legislative districts until the new Representatives shall have been duly elected and qualified.
Implementing Rules and Regulations. - The Commission on Elections shall issue the necessary rules and regulations to implement this Act within thirty (30) days upon the effectivity of this Act.
Repealing Clause. - All laws, rules and regulations which are inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.
Effectivity. - This Act shall effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in any newspaper of general circulation.
